subject.title: fix(memory): report indexed vector store in status

question: Should plain `openclaw memory status` treat persisted `vectorDims` as enough to report the builtin vector store ready, while reserving `--deep` for the live sqlite-vec probe?
rationale: The patch is a clean bug fix, but it deliberately changes the meaning of the plain status and JSON readiness signal from current-process probe state to prior successful vector indexing, which is a maintainer-owned status contract choice.

options.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
options.body: Land this PR if maintainers agree that plain status should report prior successful vector indexing from persisted metadata and leave live loadability to `--deep`.

options.title: Require Live-Probe Semantics
options.body: Revise the PR if `Vector store: ready` must mean current-process sqlite-vec loadability, likely by changing wording or exposing a separate indexed-vector signal.

options.title: Pause For Another Contract
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and pause this PR if maintainers want a different status contract or broader memory status redesign.

recommendation.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
recommendation.body: Land this PR if maintainers agree that plain status should report prior successful vector indexing from persisted metadata and leave live loadability to `--deep`.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is assigned to this PR and recently worked on the memory SQLite/reindex paths that determine upgrade and status semantics.
